notes.title: Roundscape Adorevia 6.8 Release
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Engine and System Improvements[/h2]

    [h3]Engine Optimization[/h3]
        Rewrote RPG Maker engine code to reduce occurrences of black screens and freezes.

    [h3]Save System Overhaul[/h3]
        [b]Auto Saves[/b]
            Slots 1 and 2 are now labeled Auto Save 1 and Auto Save 2 for clarity.
            Auto Save 1: Triggers upon every map transfer.
            Auto Save 2: Activates every five map transfers.

    [h3]Dialogue Window Enhancement[/h3]
        Increased the width of the dialogue window to display more text.
        Implemented visual improvements for better readability.

[h2]New Content and Features[/h2]

    [h3]Steam Achievements[/h3]
        Added 47 new achievements exclusive to the Steam version of Roundscape Adorevia.

    [h3]Quest Log Updates[/h3]

[/list]

[h2]Gameplay Improvements[/h2]

    [h3]Vendor Updates[/h3]
        Gnolls at Emek Rest now feature a vendor selling legendary orbs.

    [h3]Map Enhancements[/h3]
        Added a map marker for the bandit carrying the tablet in Glinda's quest.
        Changed the forge minimap icon from an exclamation mark to a crystal for better clarity.

    [h3]Interaction Improvements[/h3]
        Mayla in prison is now interactable via keyboard; she has been moved closer to the bars.
        Players can now reconsider the Mystic quest in Ornesse if previously declined.

    [h3]Quest Adjustments[/h3]
        The Tilan questline now begins in mid-Act 3 instead of mid-Act 2 to align better with the story.
        Rewrote the encounter with the Orc Soldier at Ruksana's Camp for improved narrative flow.
        Enhanced the ending of the Vesunna questline with empathy dialogue choices.

[h2]Rebalancing and Adjustments[/h2]

    [h3]Status Effect Changes[/h3]
        Paralyze, Stun, Sleep, and Confusion now have a base success chance between 75% and 90% (previously 100%) to prevent endless combat loops.

    [h3]Trait Corrections[/h3]
        Core Mage Trait: Now correctly increases magic damage instead of decreasing magic defense.
        Chosen Trait: Now correctly increases holy damage resistance instead of decreasing it.

    [h3]Skill Adjustments[/h3]
        Void Knight’s Rift Slash: Now targets a random enemy instead of the user.

    [h3]Stat Boosts[/h3]
        Rebalanced Felicia's training stat boosts for the player character.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

    [h3]Dialogue and Character Interaction[/h3]
[list]
[*]         The Headmistress now addresses the player by the correct gender.
[*]         Fixed instances where NPCs incorrectly referred to the player as "human" or used their real name during the Orc Fortress infiltration quest.
[*]         Corrected the player being referred to as "PC" during the Tishtyra and Carys quest.
[*]         Fixed Gavril's name display in dialogue boxes.
[*]         Resolved issues where the player class remained as "Ship" after disembarking in the Eastern Expanse.
[/list]

    [h3]Quest Log and Progression[/h3]
        [b]Quest Completion Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]             "Hunt for the Relics" now completes after receiving the sword artifact.
[*]             "Hard as Iron" no longer remains in the quest log after failure.
[*]             Fixed stuck quest markers for Amatum, Jerrah, and Mayla.
[*]             The Ice Spirit quest now completes correctly when stealing or discarding the bag.
[*]             Resolved an issue where the Paladin quest remained in the quest log after opposing the church.
[/list]

    [h3]Event and Scene Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]         Fixed a black screen issue when entering the Paladin Room post-quest.
[*]         Resolved a bug where declining Demon Beatrice's offer and re-entering the cave caused the player to become stuck.
[*]         Fixed a dialogue freeze with Carys at the Slinsk Inn.
[*]         Corrected the ability to repeat Ursula's dialogue at the Tilan Bathhouse.
[*]         Addressed issues with the Female PC's questline involving the Castle Cave Dragon.
[*]         Fixed Felicia incorrectly stating that no guards are active.
[*]         Adjusted the parallax map cut-off during the Templar origin.
[*]         Ensured the Succubus rejoins the party when siding with the Paladin.
[*]         Fixed teleport issues when escaping the wasp fight in Slinsk.
[*]         Updated the forge minimap icon from an exclamation mark to a crystal for better clarity.
[/list]
